programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: It's a high-stakes "Wednesday evening pickleball party" on Day 6 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) as Pune United takes on the Chennai Super Champs at the CCI Brabourne Stadium. With both teams currently sitting low on the points table (fifth and sixth), this game is a crucial must-win for both, offering a chance for one team to gain much-needed inspiration and move up the standings.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League returns for an explosive Season 2 at the iconic Jio World Garden in BKC, Mumbai. The season opener features a high-stakes rematch of last year's final: the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans, owned by cinematic powerhouse Atlee and Priya Atlee, take on the formidable Pune United, led by owner Riteish Deshmukh. Witness world-class athletes from 18 countries compete in a series of intense Men’s Singles, Women’s Doubles, and Mixed Doubles matches. With the pressure of a "Davis Cup" atmosphere and the precision of tactical "kitchen" play, both teams battle for every point to establish early dominance in India’s premier pickleball league.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Welcome to Championship Sunday at the NCPA Utah Regional 2025. This Round of 16 Collegiate Team Match pits the 5th-seeded Utah Tech against the 12th-seeded, but formidable, Utah State squad. The action takes place at Club Pickleball USA in Orem, Utah. Both teams are competing for a coveted bid to the National Championship in Saint Louis, Missouri, which features a $30,000 prize pool.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: Experience a high-stakes "teeter-totter" battle as Utah State and Utah Tech 2 face off in the semifinals of the 2024 DUPR Nevada Super Regional. The atmosphere in Henderson is electric as Utah Tech’s young phenom, 15-year-old Mary Monson, showcases incredible shot sequencing and skill in the opening Women's Doubles match. After an intense start where each side fights for every inch of the court at Lifetime Fitness, the match reaches a fever pitch in the Mixed Doubles rounds. With a trip to the finals on the line, the rivalry culminates in a dramatic Dream Breaker, proving that in collegiate pickleball, no lead is safe until the final point is served.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: NCPA Quarterfinals: Utah Valley vs Virgina in the 2025 NCPA Championships from Las Vegas.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The NPL women face off as the Drivers take on the Bruisers.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the final showdown of the league stages as Delhi Dilwale and the Rajasthan Titans clash in a high-stakes battle for pride and final positioning. The atmosphere is electric as Rajasthan’s Lorena Dupnik delivers a "professional performance" in a come-from-behind singles victory against Delhi’s Mehek Kuan, setting a fierce tone for the tie. Witness a tactical masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the relentless power of Max Mantor and the "next level" skills of Trang Huynh as they attempt to dismantle the Titans’ defensive wall. With veteran Rob Cassidy making his highly anticipated men's doubles debut, every rally becomes a desperate fight for dominance in the season's final league encounter.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2019
programme.desc: April 28, 2019 - May 4, 2019 at the East Naples Community Park in Naples, Florida

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Senior Pro’s Andre Mick & Jose Derisi battles against Altaf Merchant & John Cincola at the Naples, Florida.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2022
programme.desc: Championship Court hosts a star-studded final as brothers Ben and Collin Johns take on Matt Wright and Riley Newman in this Men’s Pro Doubles finale. Packed with elite strategy, blistering hand battles, and dramatic swings, this is top-tier pickleball at its most intense.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the electrifying atmosphere of the Joola Showcase at the NCPA Nationals, where the top 12 collegiate athletes in America converge for a high-octane battle between Team Hyperion and Team Perseus. The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. In a Freestyle display of athleticism, stars like Jaden Broderick and Alexandra McDonald trade "exhibition-style" points in a quest to secure premium Yola paddles for their victory. This high-energy showdown serves as the ultimate prelude to Championship Sunday, proving that the future of pickleball is brighter than ever.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Oklahoma City Punishers take on the Kansas City Stingers in a men's match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Dylan Frazier and Milan Rane take on Yana Newell and Yates Johnson in this Mixed Pro Doubles Backdraw Semifinal.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The atmosphere is electric at Pickle and Social in Buford, Georgia, as two collegiate titans clash for the regional title. The Florida Gators and North Carolina Tar Heels bring intense firepower and strategic brilliance to the court in a series of high-stakes doubles matches. With the championship on the line, every dink and drive counts as these elite athletes fight to cement their legacy on the Collegiate Pickleball Tour.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Marcello Jardim and Marco Osorio go head-to-head in the Gold Medal Match of the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships. With power, precision, and nonstop intensity, this Men’s Pro Singles final showcases top-tier talent and a dramatic battle for the championship title.

programme.title: The Wager
programme.desc: Set at the scenic Troubadour Golf and Field Club in Nashville, TN, this exhibition match brings a mix of celebrity flair and friendly competition to the pickleball court. Olympian Shawn Johnson and her husband Andrew East take on TV host Jason Kennedy and pro Wes Burrows in a lighthearted yet tightly contested match that goes down to the wire. With Shawn still learning the ropes (and the rules), and Andrew channeling his athletic instincts, the duo puts up an impressive fight against the more experienced Kennedy and Burrows. It’s a fast-paced, fun-filled match full of laughs, learning moments, and great rallies—perfect for fans of lifestyle sports and celebrity matchups.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Pei-chuan Kao and Mari Humberg face off in the US Open Pickleball Championship's Women's Pro Singles backdraw quarterfinals.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: In this Pro Men's Doubles match from the 2025 Minto U.S. Open Pickleball Championships in Naples, Florida, the team of Yates and Sobex faces off against Yu and Zwiren. The match is characterized by powerful shots, strategic dinks, and a high-energy atmosphere on the custom-designed Championship court. Commentary highlights the players' transition from singles to doubles and features details about one of the players, Thomas Yu, who previously played tennis at Johns Hopkins University.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The 2024 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches a fever pitch in Dallas as the North Carolina Tar Heels and the Utah Tech Trailblazers meet for a legendary semifinal rematch of their 2022 title bout. With both teams deeply familiar with one another’s strategies, the atmosphere at Brookhaven Country Club is electric, featuring elite players like Sarah Carpenter and Avery Beck battling for every point. The high-intensity matches, including women’s and men’s doubles, push these athletes to their limits as they fight to avoid another heart-pounding "dream breaker" finish. This high-stakes showdown captures the pure spirit of collegiate pickleball, where technical precision and emotional resilience decide who advances to face the defending champions.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The storied rivalry between the North Carolina Tar Heels and the NC State Wolfpack reaches a fever pitch on the pickleball court during the 2024 DUPR Virginia Beach Super Regional semi-finals. Watch as standout players like Ian Hunter—a 2023 national challenger bracket champion—and Faith Eichner battle against NC State's seasoned duo of Peter Glass and Lauren Hutchinson. With strategic roster shifts and high-stakes rallies, both teams fight for every point to secure regional dominance and avoid a winner-take-all Dream Breaker finale. Experience the intensity of this intrastate clash as North Carolina's premier collegiate talent vies for a spot in the championship match.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025, this pivotal collegiate team match features Kennesaw State (KSU) facing off against Virginia Tech. The action kicks off with a mixed doubles showdown chosen by coin-toss winner Virginia Tech.Watch as Virginia Tech's Cody Miller and Heather Murphy bring their A-game against KSU's Yuri Yadi and Sophia Fiona. The match also features men's doubles with Kellen Funk and Cody Miller representing the Hokies, while Parth Modi and his partner fight to keep KSU's hopes alive. With crucial seeding for bracket play on the line, both teams battle through intense rallies and strategic plays in this pool play matchup.

programme.title: Pickleball England
programme.desc: Freddie Powell and Louis Laville take on Wesley Jackson and Bernie Audibert in this critical Men’s Doubles Semifinal from the 2023 English Nationals. With a spot in the championship round on the line, both teams bring their A-game—mixing sharp shot selection, strategic court positioning, and high-pressure execution. Watch as these top British players battle through tight rallies and momentum swings in a must-see semifinal clash.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Boca Raton Picklers face off against the Oklahoma City Punishers in a mixed team match.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The championship title is on the line as the Clemson Tigers face off against the powerhouse UVA Cavaliers in the DUPR Collegiate Pickleball Virginia Super Regional Finals. Witness an elite tactical battle in women's doubles as Clemson’s Fiorella Busetto and Seeley Feldman showcase their trademark gritty defensive play against the explosive "difference maker" energy of UVA’s Vivian No and Laura Lee Sing Sang. Set in the high-pressure atmosphere of Performance Pickleball RVA, the match tests Clemson's mental fortitude as they attempt a signature come-from-behind charge against a dominant Virginia start. With both squads already securing their bids to Nationals, this showdown is a pure battle for regional pride and championship hardware.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: In this fun night of Tuesday Night Pickleball, the Scottsdale Scorchers go up against the Surprise Stingers!

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: Former national champions collide in a high-stakes semifinal as the North Carolina Tar Heels take on the Utah Tech Trailblazers. With the historic opportunity to become the first program to reach three finals and potentially the first-ever two-time national champion, these "familiar foes" bring elite athleticism and championship pedigree to the court. Experience the intensity at Lifetime Peachtree Corners as raw power meets tactical precision in a pulse-pounding battle for a spot in the national championship match.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the pinnacle of collegiate pickleball as Virginia Tech and Liberty University battle for the NCPA 2025 Virginia Beach Regional title. This high-stakes championship matchup features a prize pool of $2,500 and a chance for regional dominance.The action kicks off with an elite men’s doubles match featuring Liberty’s Ben Rice and Derek Cray against Virginia Tech’s undefeated Cody Miller and Caelan Funk. The broadcast also captures intense singles play and critical mixed doubles rallies as both teams fight through high-tension dink battles and "Dreambreaker" level strategy. Watch for standout defensive plays, including ATP (Around the Post) attempts and high-speed hand battles on the Championship Court at Pickleball Virginia Beach.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: This Pro Women's Doubles match at the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships features the dynamic team of Anna Leigh Waters and Lee Waters facing off against the formidable duo of Walczak and Harris. The Waters team, known for their aggressive play and powerful shots, including Anna Leigh's unique heavy topspin cross-court backhand roll, aim to dominate the court. Walczak, a native of Poland with collegiate tennis experience, and Harris seek to overcome the Waters' early lead and challenge their expected path to the Championship court.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The energy is electric at the DUPR Illinois Super Regional as the TCU Horned Frogs battle the Michigan Wolverines for a spot in the finals. This high-stakes semifinal features elite athleticism and aggressive play, with standout moments from players like Josh and AJ. Tensions flare as the match reaches a critical boiling point, forcing teams to stay focused and aggressive through every point. With the looming pressure of a Dream Breaker and the championship on the line, this is a must-watch clash of collegiate pickleball powers.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The 2025–26 season reaches its epic conclusion as the defending champion Utah Tech Trailblazers face a "mountain to climb" against the undefeated Florida Atlantic Owls. With FAU yet to drop a game all weekend and Utah Tech’s Lauren Mercado battling through a knee injury, the stakes couldn't be higher at Life Time Peachtree Corners. Witness elite precision and "revolutionary" play in this final showdown for the national title.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The National Pickleball League heats up as the Indianapolis Drivers take on the Austin Ignite in a coed team match packed with intensity, teamwork, and standout rallies. Representing two competitive NPL franchises, this mixed showdown brings high-level play, strategic depth, and crowd-fueled energy to the court. Whether you're cheering for the Drivers or backing the Ignite, this match is a showcase of what makes NPL team pickleball exciting to watch.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: November 28, 2023 - Welcome to week 10 - season 2 of The Arizona Pickleball League! It's Tuesday Night Pickleball @ The Orchard, and the Gilbert Gladiators face-off against the Surprise Stingers.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The intensity is off the charts in this thrilling 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship semifinal as the University of Virginia looks to pull off a monumental upset against top-seeded Utah Tech University. This episode is a masterclass in high-level pickleball, featuring incredible resets, aggressive poaching, and the "tweener" skills of athletes like Christian Alshon. The momentum constantly shifts in a tightly contested match where a single missed return or a perfectly executed "shake and bake" play can make all the difference. With the score tied at 20-20, witness the incredible "soccer goalie" instincts of the players as they battle point-for-point in a dramatic finish that will leave one team celebrating and the other crushed.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Pickleball Tour
programme.desc: The DUPR Collegiate National Championship concludes with a thrilling Women's Doubles showdown as the University of Virginia (UVA) takes on Utah Tech. Watch UVA's Alexander McDonald battle Utah Tech's Cammy Bliss and Avery Beck in a high-stakes, best-of-three match.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The action continues on Day 2 of the World Pickleball League (WPL) with the highly anticipated second matchup: Delhi takes on Mumbai Pickle Power at the CCI Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai.This matchup features a spectacular lineup, including Delhi's players Alexa Schule, Eduardo Irizarry, and Willie Chung, against a strong Mumbai squad that includes Brandon Lane, Glauca Lane, and Kim Ngo.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Christine Karges and David Weinbach take on Lee Whitwell and Jaime Oncins in this Mixed Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Dylan Frazier and James Johnson take on Andrei Daescu and Gabriel Tardio in this Men's Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Naples JBB United face off against the Boca Raton Picklers in a women's match.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The grand finale of the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional Championship, the second of six regionals for the season. The rivalry matchup features the top teams from Utah Valley University and Utah Tech.This broadcast highlights the intense Men's Doubles game, where Utah Tech's star player Liam Duffin—hailed as one of the top collegiate players nationwide—teams up with Clayton Boydston to face Utah Valley's duo of Bryce Larson and Charles Case.The stakes are high: teams are competing for $5,000 in scholarship money and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis, Missouri, where $30,000 is on the line. Ultimately, Utah Tech's first team prevails, taking home the national bid and the Utah Regional title.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the electric intensity of the "Maharashtra derby" as local rivals Pune United and Mumbai Pickle Power clash at the Jio World Garden in a match hailed as one of the season's best. Mumbai ignites the home crowd with a dominant early lead, fueled by Jada Bui’s emotional victory over a "fearful" Katie Morris and a clinical masterclass from Brandon and Glauca Carvajal Lane in mixed doubles. However, the tide turns in a dramatic "tale of two halves" as Pune United mounts a stunning comeback. Witness the high-power precision of Bolin Bako as he derails Max Green’s momentum, sparking a relentless surge that sees Pune sweep the final three matches to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. This tie is a masterclass in team resilience and tactical pressure under the lights in Mumbai.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Witness a high-stakes showdown on the final day of league competition as the undefeated Chennai Super Champs face off against a determined Pune United squad in a battle for postseason momentum. The atmosphere at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden is electric, featuring a "lip-smacking" women's singles battle between European stars Katie Morris and Dominika Turkovic. As Pune fights to stay alive in the tie, coach Rusty Sobeck looks for a breakthrough in a tactical mixed doubles clash against Jonny Goldberg’s top-tier rotation. From "stunning singles fight backs" to a strategic masterclass in doubles positioning, this tie showcases the intense grit required to challenge the league's only unbeaten titan.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Lee Whitwell and Andrei Daescu take on Stefan Andren and Alix Truong in this Mixed Pro Split Age Semifinal match.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the "clash for the ages" as host city Mumbai Pickle Power takes on their fierce rivals, Delhi Dilwale, in a thrilling Day 2 encounter of the World Pickleball League Season 2. The day begins on a somber note with a tribute to the late Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Shri Ajit Pawar, as players compete with black armbands in front of a quieted stadium.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.desc: Season 8 Episode 3 kicks off our first open-water shoot of the year as Paul Ethier and Jeff Shippam make their way to the legendary Mattagami Lake for some classic spring walleye action. With competitive tournaments on pause this season, the guys revisit their favourite early-season hotspots—areas they’d normally fish under pressure—now with time to explore, adapt, and enjoy the day. From structure-hopping to dialing in the spring pattern, Paul and Jeff put their tournament instincts to work for a fun, relaxed day chasing hungry post-spawn walleye in Northern Ontario.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (175-40-3, 27 KO) will rematch KO artist Abraham Vidales (18-4, 14 KO) and Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade (64-8, 26 KO) will look to avenge his 2023 loss to the always entertaining Berjan Peposhi (32-6, 16 KO). Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).
